titles.title: ความสัมพันธ์อันตราย

description:
Drowning in debt, Jeongmin lives as a man under her twin brother’s name. 

“Hello, beautiful?”

 That’s how she becomes entangled with Seunghyun, a rumored “gay VVIP.” But there’s something strange about him. He reaches down and mutters— “You’re my type.” 

“…” 

“Though there’s something attached that I don’t like. Tsk.” 

A man who shows interest in Jeongmin, yet never lifts a finger? He wipes out the corrupt roots of the nightclub in an instant, and before she knows it, he makes Jeongmin his exclusive VVIP. But after that, Jeongmin becomes the target of bullying, and in that moment, Seunghyun appears and saves her. 

“Since when has Lee Jeongho been a woman?” 

“…” 

“Hm? Tell me, Gae-Kang." 

In the end, Jeongmin’s true identity is revealed to Seunghyun. A woman pretending to be a man. A man pretending to be gay. The moment their secrets are uncovered, their “dangerous relationship” begins.
